title: Geometry snapshot
description: Immutable derived geometry of one evaluated pattern revision in canonical units (mm, rad), usable as a read-only portable fallback (design decision ADR-006.2). Geometry is held in piece coordinates once per piece; mirrored cut instances are a layout concern. Consumers without a required extension evaluator MUST display a conforming snapshot read-only and MUST NOT offer editing of the affected pattern. Generation rules: one contour path per contour, starting at the start point of the contour's first edge in edge direction; one segment per edge in contour order with the segment kind equal to the curve type (a reversed edge runs from curve end to curve start: a cubic swaps its control points, an arc keeps its center and flips its direction); an extension curve type is approximated by line, arc or cubic segments with the same 'edgeId' within 'curveApproximationToleranceMm'; bounding boxes use the exact curve extrema; areas are exact (outer contour minus holes); interface lengths are summed interval arc lengths. Arrays are ordered as defined by digest profile d2p-digest-v1.

documentType.description: Document type discriminator of a geometry snapshot.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

createdAt.description: UTC time the snapshot was produced.

patternRef.description: Pinned pattern revision the geometry was derived from.

evaluationId.description: ID of the pattern evaluation that produced this snapshot (informative, not resolved).

sizeKey.description: Size the geometry was evaluated for. It resolves in the size system named by the inputDigests entry with role 'size-system' (D2P-REF-009).

configurationKey.description: Material/fit configuration the geometry was evaluated for.

evaluator.description: Engine, version, algorithm profile and evaluator profile that produced the geometry.

featureSetVersion.description: Version of the 'd2p:' feature types and expression nodes in use.

inputDigests.description: Digests of the pinned inputs the geometry depends on. At least one entry with role 'pattern' is mandatory; its artifactRef equals patternRef (D2P-REF-007). When sizeKey is present, an entry with role 'size-system' names the size system that defines it (D2P-REF-009).

units.description: Units declaration; always mm for length and rad for angle.

interfaces.description: Evaluated seam interface lengths, sorted by 'seamInterfaceId'.

seams.description: Evaluated seam connection lengths, sorted by 'seamConnectionId'.

extensionEvaluators.description: Extension evaluators used to produce the snapshot, sorted by 'featureType'. Omitted when none was used.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics reported while producing the geometry (may be empty).

geometryDigest.description: Digest of the object {"units", "pieces", "interfaces", "seams"} taken from this snapshot (digest profile d2p-digest-v1).

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this whole document in canonical form, excluding 'contentDigest' itself.

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

point2.title: 2D point
point2.description: Point [x, y] in mm in a 2D Cartesian system with X to the right and Y up.

segment.title: Contour segment
segment.description: One segment of a snapshot contour, discriminated by 'kind'. Each segment starts where the previous one ends (the first at the contour's 'start').

lineSegment.title: Line segment
lineSegment.description: Straight segment of a snapshot contour.

arcSegment.title: Arc segment
arcSegment.description: Circular arc segment of a snapshot contour.

cubicSegment.title: Cubic segment
cubicSegment.description: Cubic Bézier segment of a snapshot contour.

pathSegment.title: Path segment
pathSegment.description: One segment of a print path, discriminated by 'kind'. Same shapes as contour segments, without 'edgeId'.

linePathSegment.title: Line path segment
linePathSegment.description: Straight segment of a print path.

arcPathSegment.title: Arc path segment
arcPathSegment.description: Circular arc segment of a print path.

cubicPathSegment.title: Cubic path segment
cubicPathSegment.description: Cubic Bézier segment of a print path.

contourPath.title: Contour path
contourPath.description: Evaluated contour of a piece. Closure: the last segment's 'end' equals 'start' exactly after quantization (D2P-SEM-010).

start.description: Start point: the start of the contour's first edge in edge direction.

segments.description: One or more segments per edge, in contour order.

boundingBox.title: Bounding box
boundingBox.description: Axis-aligned box of the exact extrema of all contour curves (not of the control polygon), in mm.

snapshotPiece.title: Snapshot piece
snapshotPiece.description: Evaluated geometry of one pattern piece in piece coordinates. All members are required; empty arrays are written as [].

contours.description: Contour paths: the outer contour first, then holes sorted by 'contourId'.

areaMm2.description: Exact area in mm² enclosed by the outer contour minus the areas of the holes.

point.description: Point at the notch's normalized arc-length position along the edge direction.

angleRad.description: Direction of the edge tangent at 'point', in edge direction, counter-clockwise from +X, in rad, normalized to (−π, π].

snapshotGrainline.title: Snapshot grainline
snapshotGrainline.description: Evaluated grainline as a directed line from 'start' to 'end'.

snapshotFold.title: Snapshot fold
snapshotFold.description: A fold line of a piece, identified by the edge it lies on.

edgeId.description: Edge that is the fold line.

snapshotInterface.title: Snapshot interface
snapshotInterface.description: Evaluated length of one seam interface.

seamInterfaceId.description: Pattern seam interface this entry represents.

cutInstanceKey.description: Cut instance the interface belongs to, when the interface declares one.

lengthMm.description: Summed arc length of the interface's edge intervals, in mm.

snapshotSeam.title: Snapshot seam
snapshotSeam.description: Evaluated lengths of one seam connection. 'deviationMm' = 'lengthAMm' − 'lengthBMm' − 'declaredEaseMm'.

seamConnectionId.description: Pattern seam connection this entry represents.

lengthAMm.description: Length of the side A interface, in mm.

lengthBMm.description: Length of the side B interface, in mm.

declaredEaseMm.description: Ease declared by the connection, in mm; 0 when the ease mode is 'none'.

deviationMm.description: Length deviation in mm: lengthAMm − lengthBMm − declaredEaseMm.

extensionEvaluatorUse.title: Extension evaluator use
extensionEvaluatorUse.description: Records which extension evaluator produced the geometry of an extension feature type.

featureType.description: Extension feature type that was evaluated.

evaluator.description: Extension evaluator (ID and version) that was used.
